files.role_assessment: Lambda-hypernuclear binding + NS mass bounds (PRL 67 2414 1991). Not the GM1 RMF parameterization paper; the GM1 EOS parameterization was set in a separate Glendenning RMF EOS paper. Does not document SPG/GPPVA eos.compo cluster abundance conventions; C6B unaffected.
Density-dependent RMF framework (TW99). Framework basis for DD-ME2/DD2/NL3/TW; a core-EOS framework paper, not a cluster composition document. C6B unaffected.

BPS compressible-liquid-drop outer/inner crust framework (1971, predates SPG/GPPVA). Establishes free-neutron-gas + lattice-of-nuclei picture. Does not document CompOSE eos.compo row grammar, Iphase categorical index, Abar/Zav/Y_I/Y_h normalization, or the disputed final group field. C6B unaffected.

SLy4 Skyrme force parameterization (NPA 635 231 1998). Documents the Skyrme force fit; does not document the RG_SLY4 EOS cluster export or CompOSE composition. The RG_SLY4 model uses the SLy4 force but is a separate EOS (Gulminelli & Raduta, PRC 92 055803 2015, arXiv:1504.04493). C6B unaffected.

c6b_assessment_20261111.verdict: The four user-supplied papers establish physics framework/parameterization provenance for the 18 EOS families but DO NOT resolve the C6B blocker.
c6b_assessment_20261111.reason: C6B requires a written provider definition for the final group field in SPG/GPPVA eos.compo rows (Y_I, Y_h, X_h, charge fraction, free-neutron gas fraction, or another aggregate) plus independent closure. The four papers address: (a) the BPS liquid-drop crust framework (Baym 1971), (b) the SLy4 Skyrme force fit (Chabanat 1998), (c) Lambda-hypernuclear binding (Glendenning 1991), and (d) the density-dependent RMF framework (Typel 1999). None defines CompOSE eos.compo row grammar, Iphase categorical index, Abar/Zav/Y_I/Y_h normalization for a cluster group, or the disputed final group field.
missing_provider_documents: Grill et al., PRC 90, 045803 (2014), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevC.90.045803, arXiv:1404.2753 — GPPVA Thomas-Fermi inner crust; primary source for the GPPVA cluster composition convention.
Gögelein et al., PRC 77, 025802 (2008), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevC.77.025802 — SPG density-dependent RMF functional (GDFM); primary source for the SPG cluster convention.
Scurto, Pais & Gulminelli, PRD 109, 103015 (2024), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.109.103015, arXiv:2402.15548 — current CompOSE SPG(M3)/(M5) cited source for variant-specific abundance semantics.
CompOSE inner crust data sheet, arXiv:2207.14153 — CompOSE-provided documentation of the eos.compo convention for inner crust (provider-facing).

CompOSE Reference Manual v3.01 (Typel et al. 2022), arXiv:2203.03209 — defines the row grammar (iT inb iYq Iphase Npairs (particle_id,Y_i)* Nquad (group_id,Aav,Zav,YI)*) but explicitly does not resolve provider-specific meaning of the disputed field.
c6b_assessment_20261111.additional_needed_for_gm1: The GM_GM1 EOS uses the GM1 RMF parameterization, which is set in a Glendenning RMF EOS paper (commonly cited as Glendenning 1985, Ap&SS or a later RMF EOS reference), not in Glendenning & Moszkowski 1991 PRL 67 2414 (which addresses Lambda-hypernuclear binding). Confirm the exact GM1 parameterization citation from the CompOSE GM_GM1 eos.pdf data sheet before claiming GM_GM1 provenance is fully secured.

c6b_resolution_20261111.summary: The CompOSE manual v3.01 explicitly defines the disputed final group field YI as the combined number fraction (eq. 4.22). The standard is documented. Direct verification against actual SPG/GPPVA eos.compo rows shows the provider export deviates from the standard in inner-crust rows (YI = Ye instead of the number fraction). The parser reads the field as the manual's YI and flags deviations as row_status=FAIL (M2A). Production use still requires a written provider clarification; C6B is no longer a parser blocker, it is a provider-data-quality blocker.
